acip: CI LU PA'I 'DUS KYI 'GREL PA LAS, RNAM PA GNYIS SU DBYER MA MCHIS SO, ,ZHES PA NI BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS RDO RJE'I CHOS KYI SKU LAS LONGS SPYOD RDZOGS PA 'BYUNG ZHING DE NYID KYI SPRUL PA'I GZUGS RNAM PAR GNAS PA MTHONG BA'I LAM DU MI 'GYUR BA'I DUS SU DE'I LUS LA RNAM PAR GNAS NAS GZHAN GYI LAS KYI SGRIB PA LA SOGS SBYONG BAR BYED PAS NA'O, ,ZHES SANGS RGYAS DNGOS SU MTHONG MI NUS PA DA LTA 'DRA BA'I DUS SU SANGS RGYAS RNAMS RDO RJE SLOB DPON GYI LUS LA BZHUGS NAS SEMS CAN GYI DON MDZAD PAR GSUNGS SO,
wylie: ci lu pa'i 'dus kyi 'grel pa las, rnam pa gnyis su dbyer ma mchis so, ,zhes pa ni byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i chos kyi sku las longs spyod rdzogs pa 'byung zhing de nyid kyi sprul pa'i gzugs rnam par gnas pa mthong ba'i lam du mi 'gyur ba'i dus su de'i lus la rnam par gnas nas gzhan gyi las kyi sgrib pa la sogs sbyong bar byed pas na'o, ,zhes sangs rgyas dngos su mthong mi nus pa da lta 'dra ba'i dus su sangs rgyas rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la bzhugs nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsungs so
english: Chilupa's commentary to the Secret Collection says too that "They are completely indivisible."   What this is saying is that the paradise body of the being known as the Diamond Mind of Enlightenment arises from his Dharma body.  We live though in times where we are unable even to lay eyes upon the bodies of emanation in which these other bodies reside. And so the Enlightened Ones come and stay in the body of our Master, so that they can help others purify themselves of their karmic obstacles, and other such problems. The point is that in times like the present day, when people are unable to see a Buddha in the flesh, then the Enlightened Ones come and enter into the body of our Diamond Master, and thus perform Their deeds of benefit for every living being. ***
